Dish Making.Anchor Frame: Food materials or incomplete food components before forming a complete edible product.
Dish Making.Outcome Frame: The completed edible product formed from the same materials or components.

Food Transformation.Anchor Frame: The target food item before a visible cooking-related state change.
Food Transformation.Outcome Frame: The same food item after the cooking-related state change.

Food Plating.Anchor Frame: Existing food components before final spatial arrangement or presentation.
Food Plating.Outcome Frame: The completed food presentation after arrangement, decoration, or composition.

Styling.Anchor Frame: The target person before a visible appearance change.
Styling.Outcome Frame: The same person after the appearance change has been completed.

Tool Cleaning.Anchor Frame: The target beauty or fashion tool before cleaning.
Tool Cleaning.Outcome Frame: The same tool after it has been cleaned into a reusable state.

Try-on.Anchor Frame: The target subject or external appearance specification before application.
Try-on.Outcome Frame: The target subject after the external appearance specification has been applied.

Product Reveal.Anchor Frame: The target product before it is fully visible.
Product Reveal.Outcome Frame: The same product after it has been revealed and is clearly visible.

Gear Setup.Anchor Frame: The target sports gear or equipment before functional configuration.
Gear Setup.Outcome Frame: The same gear or equipment after it has been configured for use.

Body Preparation.Anchor Frame: The target subject before entering a sports-ready state.
Body Preparation.Outcome Frame: The same subject after reaching a sports-ready state.

Sports Edits.Anchor Frame: The source sports-related visual material or identity cues before media completion.
Sports Edits.Outcome Frame: The completed edited sports media product.

Assembly.Outcome Frame: The completed structure or object assembled from those components.

Restoration.Anchor Frame: The target object before condition improvement.
Restoration.Outcome Frame: The same object after restoration, refurbishment, or repair.

Renovation.Anchor Frame: The target built space before spatial reconfiguration.
Renovation.Outcome Frame: The same built space after reorganization, remodeling, or renovation.

Blueprint Construction.Anchor Frame: The abstract design specification before physical realization.
Blueprint Construction.Outcome Frame: The physical structure built according to that specification.

Material Shaping.Anchor Frame: The target material before physical reshaping.
Material Shaping.Outcome Frame: The same material after it has been reshaped into a new form.

Plant Treatment.Anchor Frame: The target plant before treatment or care.
Plant Treatment.Outcome Frame: The same plant after its state has been adjusted or improved through treatment or care.

Floral Design.Anchor Frame: Plant or floral components before compositional arrangement.
Floral Design.Outcome Frame: The completed floral or plant-based design after arrangement.

Pet Grooming.Outcome Frame: The same pet after grooming has improved its visible appearance.

Digital Creation.Anchor Frame: The digital reference, specification, workspace, or incomplete digital work before completion.

Sculpting.Anchor Frame: The target sculptable material before completion as a three-dimensional artwork.
